name: Micronesia, Federated States of

findings.controller: HMN Technologies (formerly Huawei Marine Networks; majority-owned by Hengtong Optic-Electric)
findings.local_actor: Government of the Federated States of Micronesia (with Nauru and Kiribati)
findings.reversal_of: HMN Technologies' lowest-price bid in the World Bank-led East Micronesia Cable tender
findings.summary: The World Bank-led East Micronesia Cable tender, in which HMN Technologies bid about 20% below NEC and Alcatel Submarine Networks, ended with no award after the US warned FSM in 2020 that the Chinese bidder posed a security risk.
findings.analyst_inference: Formal World Bank reason was that all three bids were non-responsive; sources attribute the stall to US security objections, so reason coded geopolitical. Tier 2 is a reviewer call: the reversed item was a pre-award bid, not a signed contract. US$72.6m is reported as HMN's bid/project value. still_current true because the cable was later built by NEC (FSM-002).

findings.local_actor: FSM Telecommunications Cable Corporation (co-owner with BwebwerikiNet and Nauru Fibre Cable Corporation)
findings.builder: NEC (cable supply and installation); DXN (cable landing stations)
findings.financier: Governments of Australia, Japan and the United States (grants)
findings.summary: After a re-run competitive tender, NEC won the East Micronesia Cable contract in June 2023; it finished construction linking Kosrae and Pohnpei to Nauru and Kiribati and handed the system to its three owners by May 2026.

sources.publisher: Australian Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade

findings.analyst_inference: Pole third: equipment vendor NEC is Japanese. Tier 4 rather than 5 because sources confirm construction completion and handover but not commercial service at scale. DFAT gives an estimated AUD 135m overall project cost; not converted, value left null. Pohnpei lands at the existing HANTRU-1 landing point. In 2021 Reuters reported ~US$14m of US American Rescue Plan funds for a Kosrae–Pohnpei segment, apparently folded into this project.
